structured_output.what_is_happening: A late copy of an "Effective Accelerationism" (e/acc) token, about 12 minutes old. It is one of at least 10 same-name tokens launched in the past hour or so. It links to a Beff Jezos X status, so it is probably a reaction to a Beff Jezos post. The trigger came from a +280-430% first pump followed by a sharp pullback (-42% m5 at detection, -27% m5 at collection). There are about 2,083 unique buyers but only 77 unique sellers, with 7 bundlers and 9 snipers among the tagged wallets. RugCheck shows one holder at 80% (unlabeled; possibly an unlabeled pool account) and a 49-wallet insider trade network. The creator has launched 11 tokens.

narrative.description: e/acc / Beff Jezos. The catalyst looks like a real post from a well-known account, and the meme has a real cultural base. But demand is spread across many clones.
narrative.why_spreading: A Beff Jezos post probably started a burst of e/acc launches. Traders are spreading across clones, and several of them (7dVW, 13vV, 3m7B) are doing $5-16M in hourly volume, far more than this one.

token_connection.why_this_token: None stands out. It links the same Beff Jezos status as the others, and its website field points to a different clone's contract (Cbcy...). It is one of the later launches.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 9 same-name tokens: Cbcy ($696k), DseC ($759k), 7dVW ($349k, $15.5M h1 volume), 13vV ($233k, $16.4M h1 volume), 3m7B ($341k), plus others. There is also an old 2024 pump.fun e/acc, and a J246 token showing an $850M market cap, which is probably fake or illiquid.

authenticity.evidence: The buyer count is broad (2,083), but only 77 unique sellers against 2,600 buys looks bot-like or like a spread-out distribution. There are 7 bundlers, 9 snipers and a 49-wallet insider network. There is no paid promotion. The catalyst itself is probably organic.
authenticity.uncertainty: We can't tell whether the 80% holder is a pool/curve account or a single wallet. The packet disagrees with itself: RugCheck says 99.99% of LP is unlocked, while GMGN reports an LP burn ratio of 1.0.

structural_risks: A serial creator (11 launches) with a creator_close status
A sharp dump already under way after the first pump

structured_output.counterargument: The Beff Jezos catalyst is real and heavily followed. If this clone gets picked as the "winner" (for example, through a quote or retweet), $200-260k is still cheap next to $700k clones, and 2x is only about $520k. Market cap has also recovered from $200k to $261k between detection and collection.
unknowns: Whether Beff Jezos has endorsed any particular contract
Whether the burst of clone launches has already peaked

structured_output.thesis: This is a late, non-canonical copy of the e/acc token during a clone war, from a serial deployer, with worrying concentration and LP data. Attention is real but split across clones, and bigger clones already hold most of the volume. A 2x before -50% is unlikely; a fade or pull is more likely.
